resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source plane-wave DFT code supporting PBE)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT code that supports PBE and geometry relaxation (e.g., GPAW, ABINIT) can be used. The paper originally used CASTEP but the task is scoped to an open-source equivalent.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials (e.g., SSSP PBEsol efficiency library or standard PBE pseudopotentials for Lu, B, C)

access.notes: Standard PBE pseudopotentials for Lu, B, C. The agent must select appropriate ones for the chosen DFT code.
